name: Family Gmail Import (Cron - extract + Telegram confirm loop)

nodes.name: Search household senders
nodes.notes: q's from:(...) is a plain n8n-side allowlist filter, not backend logic — same 'thin trigger' spirit as the Telegram chat-id binding elsewhere. Only used to find matching message ids here; the next node fetches each message's real content, since Gmail's simplified snippet is too short to contain anything past a forwarded email's header block.

nodes.name: Get full message
nodes.notes: simple: false returns the raw MIME payload (headers + base64url-encoded body parts) instead of the truncated snippet — necessary for forwarded emails, where the real content sits well past what a short snippet preview would capture.
